dataRoles.name: category
dataRoles.description: Optional bar labels (e.g., department names). If omitted, each Value measure becomes its own row.

dataRoles.name: measure
dataRoles.description: Current value for each bar. Multiple measures are supported; without a Category, each measure becomes its own row.

dataRoles.name: target
dataRoles.description: Optional max/target value (defaults to max of all values). Without a Category, bind one shared Target or one Target per Value measure.
